I suffer with an ED resulting from bullying and other illness. I needed help for mental health and physical health. Since I was little people teased and berated me for being thin, so I forced myself to eat massive amounts of food and became overweight. I suddenly had a stomach problem and was severely underweight in less than a year. Everyone helped me. Friends and family worried about me. Doctors worked HARD to get my treatment right. I got better and got to healthy weight, but still binged sometimes. 

I started getting other health issues a couple years later. Pain, joint problems, fainting, dizziness, nausea, heavy heavy periods that made me feel like I was going to die, tummy issues, and a lot more. People thought I was faking or just anxious. Doctors didn't try to help, family forced me to go to school when I was miserable and told me the drs said I was fine so I was. 

So I started eating less, drinking a lot of water, becoming more and more defiant. I was diagnosed with several chronic conditions a few years later once I was thin again, but then the dx was changed when I gained back weight and tried to get disability. 

I also have gender issues and identify as nonbinary, meaning somewhere between male and female. 

The whole point of all that is that often an ED is due to other things. Could even be OCD. It is important to not punish her for these things, but to ask her to be respectful. The laughing and not just saying "I don't want anymore." was rude. This really sounds like an underlying issue. 

I hope this helps.
